verses.text: "Say to your brothers, 'You are my people,' and to your sisters, 'You are loved.'

"Bring charges against your mother! Bring charges, because she is not my wife, and I am not her husband. Let her stop acting like a prostitute. Let her remove the signs of her unfaithfulness from her face and from between her breasts.
If she does not, I will strip her naked and leave her as bare as the day she was born. I will make her like a desert, like a dry land, and let her die of thirst.
I will not show love to her children, because they are children of unfaithfulness.

Their mother has been unfaithful. She who gave birth to them has acted shamefully. She said, 'I will go after my lovers. They give me my food and my water, my wool and my linen, my olive oil and my drink.'
"So I will block her path with thornbushes. I will build a wall around her so that she cannot find her way.

She will chase after her lovers but will not catch them. She will look for them but will not find them. Then she will say, 'I will go back to my husband as I was before, because I was better off then than I am now.'
She has not admitted that I was the one who gave her the grain, the new wine, and the olive oil. I gave her plenty of silver and gold, but they used it for Baal.
"So I will take back my grain when it is ripe and my new wine when it is ready. I will take away my wool and my linen, which were meant to cover her naked body.
Now I will expose her shame in front of her lovers. No one will rescue her from my power.
I will put an end to all her celebrations: her yearly festivals, her New Moons, her Sabbaths, and all her appointed feasts.
I will destroy her vines and her fig trees. She said they were the pay her lovers gave her. I will turn them into a thicket, and wild animals will eat them.
I will punish her for the days she burned incense to the Baals. She put on her rings and jewelry and went after her lovers, but she forgot me," says the LORD.
"But now I will win her back. I will lead her into the wilderness and speak tenderly to her.
There I will give her back her vineyards, and I will make the Valley of Trouble a door of hope. There she will respond to me as she did when she was young, as on the day she came up out of Egypt.
"On that day," says the LORD, "you will call me 'my husband.' You will no longer call me 'my master.'
I will remove the names of the Baals from her lips. Their names will never be spoken again.

On that day I will make a covenant for my people with the wild animals, the birds of the sky, and the creatures that move along the ground. I will remove bows, swords, and war from the land, so that my people can rest in safety.
I will make you my wife forever. I will make you my wife with goodness and fairness, with faithful love and mercy.
I will make you my wife with faithfulness, and you will know the LORD.
"On that day I will answer," says the LORD. "I will answer the skies, and they will answer the earth.
The earth will answer with grain, new wine, and olive oil, and they will answer Jezreel.
I will plant her for myself in the land. I will show love to the one I called 'not loved.' I will say to those I called 'not my people,' 'You are my people.' And they will say, 'You are my God.'"
